chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about a free man who had a female slave under his ownership, and he divorced her with a final divorce, then he bought her back; is it permissible for him to have sexual relations with her? He said: No.

key_terms.يَطَأَهَا: To have sexual relations with her

ai.seo_question: Can a master have sexual relations with a female slave he divorced and then bought back?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that a final divorce (taliqah bā'in) severs the marital bond such that mere repurchase of the slave does not automatically restore the right of possession (tamalluk) for sexual relations. This ruling highlights the distinct legal status of the 'free man owning a slave' category, where the divorce is considered complete and irrevocable without a new contract or explicit reinstatement, reflecting the rigorous application of family law principles in Shia jurisprudence.
